invites_kind_partner_chk.name: invites_kind_partner_chk
invites_kind_partner_chk.value:
("invites"."kind" = 'partner' and "invites"."partner_id" is not null and "invites"."role" in ('partner_admin', 'sales', 'technical') and "invites"."staff_region" is null)
        or ("invites"."kind" = 'staff' and "invites"."partner_id" is null and "invites"."role" in ('partner_manager', 'sales', 'marketing') and "invites"."staff_region" is not null)

users_kind_partner_role_chk.name: users_kind_partner_role_chk
users_kind_partner_role_chk.value:
("users"."kind" = 'partner' and "users"."partner_id" is not null and "users"."role" in ('partner_admin', 'sales', 'technical'))
        or ("users"."kind" = 'staff' and "users"."partner_id" is null and "users"."role" in ('partner_manager', 'sales', 'marketing'))
